name: reach_globe
description: A panel over the top half while the speaker moves to the bottom half: a title typed in letter by letter, a label popping under it, and a turning globe where arcs fly out from a home pin to other places that light up. For reach and growth: other cities, all regions, abroad, the whole country, the area a business delivers to.

title.description: The title, e.g. 'Dunyo'. Written in capitals by the code.

pill.description: The label under it, e.g. 'bozoriga', 'viloyatlarga'. Written in capitals by the code.

home.description: Optional: two or three letters on the home pin, e.g. 'UZ', 'TSH'.

places.description: Optional: up to five places the arcs reach, in the order they are said, e.g. 'Samarqand'.

beats.lands: The word the label pops in on.
beats.places: Each place lights up on the word that names it, in order.
